stem: What is the worst-case running time of binary search on a sorted array of n elements?
explanation: Each comparison halves the remaining interval, giving logarithmically many steps.

subject: Algorithms
stem: What is merge sort's worst-case time complexity?
explanation: Merge sort has log n levels and O(n) merging work per level, yielding O(n log n).
